docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,246.00 FILED BY RATHBUN MARY AS TO DEFENDANT SAN FRANCISCO HOUSING AUTHORITY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-11-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT SAN FRANCISCO HOUSING AUTHORITY

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RATHBUN MARY IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SAN FRANCISCO HOUSING AUTHORITY TO ALLOW PLTF TO FILE CLAIM AGAINST HOUSING AUTHORITY STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
